description: This source file defines a custom ASP.NET Core MVC controller convention class 'GroupByApiRootConvention' implementing 'IControllerModelConvention'. The class modifies controller metadata to set API grouping based on route attributes for API versioning purposes.

classes.name: GroupByApiRootConvention
classes.description: A custom controller convention class that groups API controllers based on route attributes to facilitate API versioning or grouping

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Applies the convention to a controller, setting its ApiExplorer GroupName based on the route attribute's template
